answer: The lantern chain is verified at intake and spiral publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a yarrow checkpoint. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 27 percent more locked value. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
